patch.summary: Zenzap cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Zenzap pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: Zenzap cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Zenzap against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (call recording (Free, Pro, Business+, Enterprise)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (call recording, team messaging, video meetings) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Integrations with other business tools and API access require Business+. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Frontline, multi-site and shift-based teams replacing personal WhatsApp groups requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Integrations with other business tools and API access require Business+
Side-by-side cost with Wati on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Integrations with other business tools and API access require Business+

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Voice and video calls require Pro; call recording and transcription require Business+

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Free tier is capped at 1 GB of secure file storage

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: No customer-facing channels — no PSTN calling, SMS, WhatsApp Business API or shared customer inbox

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Reporting is limited to admin/audit surfaces rather than communication analytics

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Zenzap on identical constraints.

blocks.body: Use researched plan structure for Zenzap alongside category cost modelling.
